_comment: Illustrative accessorial charge model for demo purposes. Real fee amounts and trigger thresholds vary by carrier, change roughly annually (each carrier publishes a General Rate Increase each January), and depend on the shipper's actual service agreement.

dimWeight.note: Domestic DIM divisor of 139 in^3/lb, applied to all shipments regardless of size (industry standard since 2015 for UPS/FedEx). Billable weight is the greater of actual and dimensional weight.

deliveryAreaSurcharge.note: DAS/EDAS applies to specific carrier-defined remote ZIP codes. This prototype flags a small illustrative sample of ZIP3 prefixes to demonstrate the feature — it is not an authoritative DAS zip list. A production version would sync the carrier's official DAS zip file.

addressCorrectionFee.note: Billed by the carrier only if they correct an inaccurate address after pickup — not knowable pre-shipment, so it is never added to a quote. The assistant should proactively mention it when destination details look uncertain.
